Architecture

A React and TypeScript client connects to an ASP.NET Core API. Separate Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers organize business logic and SQL Server persistence.

Engineering decisions

  • Separate chat responsibilities. An authenticated SignalR hub delegates message persistence, presence tracking, and delivery to dedicated services.
  • Support trust beyond sign-in. JWT-backed HttpOnly sessions, Google sign-in, and two-factor support sit alongside seller reviews and an admin report queue.

Tests in the repository

Dedicated tests exercise chat orchestration, search validation, and API contracts.

ASP.NET CoreReactRedux ToolkitEF CoreSQL Server
Explore the build — CarePoint

Architecture

ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework Core handle booking and clinical rules within a layered architecture. React, TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit power the patient, doctor, and admin portals.

Engineering decisions

  • Keep bookings consistent. Serializable transactions wrap doctor-slot and patient-overlap checks before an appointment is saved.
  • Detect concurrent edits. SQL Server row versions catch stale medical-record and prescription updates, with conflicts returned as HTTP 409 responses.
  • Check each document request. Access rules consider roles, ownership, and the treating doctor's appointment relationship before streaming a file.

Tests in the repository

Dedicated tests cover scheduling conflicts, document permissions and cleanup, and concurrent updates against SQL Server.

Booking logic ↗ Document access ↗ SQL Server tests ↗

ASP.NET CoreReactJavaScriptEF CoreSQL Server
Explore the build — StockPilot

Architecture

A React JavaScript client with Material UI and TanStack Query connects to an ASP.NET Core API. Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers separate business rules from persistence and HTTP endpoints.

Engineering decisions

  • Commit related changes together. Orders, stock balances, movement history, and retry receipts are saved atomically.
  • Enforce permissions at the API. Admin and Staff can edit; Viewer has read-only access. HttpOnly cookie sessions and CSRF validation protect authenticated mutations.

Tests in the repository

Integration tests cover authentication, inventory adjustments, purchasing, sales, and reports. The repository includes a local demo guide; a hosted demo is not yet available.
